description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'ReportAPI' within the OrangeHRM project, which provides REST API endpoints for handling report resources. It includes methods for retrieving report details and enforces certain REST operations to be unimplemented, consistent with API resource management practices.

classes.name: ReportAPI
classes.description: An abstract REST API class providing report resource endpoints, including methods to retrieve report data and headers, but not supporting modifications or deletions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a report's header and filter definitions, returning them in a resource result.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the report object.

methods.name: getReportName
methods.description: Returns the report name from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne request, based on report name parameters.

methods.name: getReportNameParamRule
methods.description: Defines the validation rule for the report name parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method to update a report resource, intentionally not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for update, not implemented and throws exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method to delete a report resource, not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete, not implemented and throws exception.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Method to obtain a not implemented exception, used for unimplemented REST methods.
